The two files now carry the paper's figure numbers for the P6 and cluster figures, and I closed `figtab-repo`#6. Fig. 10 is the P6 interval (`figP6_interval`) and Fig. 11 is the graph-cluster designs (`fig6_cluster`).

I changed `figures/CAPTIONS.md` (the numbering list and the two section headings) and `REPRODUCE.md` section 9 (the two table rows). The commit is 831849a, pushed to `dev` after pulling and rebasing onto the current head.

The latest system build of `dev` is at dc219fe, older than the current head. It has the new numbering: its captions read "Figure 10: A bound on the unidentified part buys coverage by width…" and "Figure 11: Graph-cluster randomisation…". I could not check the numbers against a build of the newest head, but the figure order in the source gives the same numbering.
